::: {#sol-shift-conv}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
digit = x_test[:1]
with torch.no_grad():
    out_of_shifted = conv(shift_right(digit))
    shifted_out = shift_right(conv(digit))
gap = (out_of_shifted - shifted_out).abs()
gap_inside = gap[..., 1:].max().item()
gap_first_col = gap[..., 0].max().item()
print(gap_inside, gap_first_col)
```

The output for the shifted digit is the original output shifted one pixel right.
Each output pixel is the same [filter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-filter) applied to the patch around it,
so moving every patch moves every output.
In columns 1 to 7 of every [channel](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-channel) of `conv`,
`r if (py$gap_inside == 0) "the two agree exactly" else sprintf("the two differ by at most %.1e", py$gap_inside)`.
In column 0 they differ by up to `r sprintf("%.2f", py$gap_first_col)`.
There `shift_right()` fills the shifted output with 0,
while the layer applies its filter and bias to the new blank column.

:::
